releases.title: Tenant preference policies
releases.summary: Tenant administrators can set defaults and lock preferences for each application. Personal choices return when a setting is unlocked.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Use Preferences to choose the appearance, language and behavior of your application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

tour.title: Layout
tour.text: Sidebar side, form style, result view, quick view and page size. Honoured by every module and page.

tour.title: Sidebar
tour.text: Placement, hover or click to open, pinning, and the rail's own palette — which can be a different theme from the page.

tour.title: Themes
tour.text: 14 themes; every component picks up tokens instantly. Each card is drawn with that theme's real colours.

tour.title: Typography

tour.title: Toasts

paragraphs: Use Preferences to choose the appearance, language and behavior of your application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

MRN and registration fields are system-managed. Add names, contacts, documents and other repeated details as needed. Document upload stages file metadata only. Theme, layout and density controls use application preferences and cannot override administrator locks.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.
